notes: Party is the party a voter registered with, never the ballot cast.
Comparisons are with the same day of voting in 2022 and 2024 (or the same days before the election where a state's first day of voting is not on record), as on callthemap.com/early-vote.
Ratios are this year's ballots over the earlier year's at the same point; gaps are D share minus R share of ballots, in points.
